summary.text: Jan Maino is the Democratic candidate for the Michigan House of Representatives, District 46, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Kathy Schmaltz. A social worker and mental health therapist, she serves on the East Jackson Community Schools board.

paragraphs.text: Jan Maino earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern Michigan University in 1994 and a graduate degree from the same university in 1999, according to Ballotpedia.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as social work and her office as an at-large member of the East Jackson Community Schools board, with a term ending in 2026.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Maino said she has lived in Jackson County for nearly 50 years and has spent more than three decades working as a social worker, nonprofit leader and mental health therapist.
She said she has served on the East Jackson School Board for more than 13 years, including as board president.
She said she is running to strengthen public education, expand access to affordable health and mental health care, support working families and create more economic opportunity.
